definition: Panela, dulce, confite, miel de abeja
additional_text: sInv Nukabʼ Ruyaʼal kabʼ (ruyaʼal cheʼ) Miel de abeja

examples.example_maya: Ri kabʼ, chi re ri ajiʼj elenäq wi
examples.example_spa: De la caña de azúcar sacan la panela

examples.example_maya: Ri kabʼ yalan jebʼel nkinaʼ ri akʼwalaʼ
